issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares lectureName as type int while all other parts of the exercise (task descriptions, example toString(), and the provided solution) treat lectureName as a String. This contradiction in the problem specification can mislead students about the correct type for lectureName and may cause them to implement the attribute incorrectly.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the UML and any type annotations in the problem statement to declare lectureName as String (e.g. lectureName: String) to match the task descriptions and the solution. Ensure the UML and example usages consistently use String for lectureName so students implement the attribute with the intended type.
